x-summary: An allergy or intolerance, how serious it is and the reaction.
title: AllergyIntolerance
description: FHIR AllergyIntolerance-flavored (not conformant) record. Field names checked against the vendored priv/fhir/R5/fhir.schema.json; the code lists (clinicalStatus, verificationStatus, type, category, criticality, reaction severity) are FHIR's value sets from memory, since that file doesn't carry them — same caveat as medical_condition. FHIR allows several categories and reactions per record; this form supports several categories and one reaction.

code.description: The substance, as free text plus optional coded terms.

category.description: FHIR AllergyIntolerance.category (0..*). A single string until x-version 2; App.People.RecordMigrations upgrades old records.

criticality.x-help: How dangerous a future reaction could be. High means potentially life-threatening.

reactionManifestation.description: FHIR reaction.manifestation, free text (e.g. anaphylaxis, hives).

reactionSeverity.x-help: How severe the reaction was when it happened.
